purpose: Give Mythical Void one recognisable public identity across channels without claiming somebody else's account, opening accounts for Kevin or publishing before the studio is ready.

canonicalIdentity.rule: Keep the display name Mythical Void. Check the handle inside each platform at the moment Kevin creates the account; a missing public profile does not prove availability.

exactNameFindings.observation: An unrelated channel uses the exact handle.
An unrelated or reserved profile uses the exact handle.
An unrelated account uses the exact handle.
The public address returned an unavailable page. That does not prove the address can be claimed.
An unrelated community using the Mythical Void name was visible in public search.

publicAudit.rule: Do not contact, challenge, copy or imply ownership of unrelated accounts. Use the full game name and official website to make the real studio easy to recognise.

openingOrder.reason: It can tell the true father-and-son beginning without opening another account.
Reserve a consistent identity, but publish no video until four real gameplay moments pass human review.
Only reserve these if Kevin can own recovery, multi-factor security and human moderation.
The name collision and child-safety moderation burden make this a poor first channel.

kevinActionChecklist: Approve PlayMythicalVoid as the first handle to try and MythicalVoidGame as the fallback.
Check availability inside each platform before confirming the account.
Use an account Kevin already controls where the platform permits it; no second Google Workspace subscription is required for YouTube.
Accept platform terms personally and keep passwords, recovery addresses and codes outside the repository.
Turn on multi-factor authentication and name a trusted adult backup before publishing.
Return only the finished public address so the website can link to the verified official account.
publicationRules: Do not add a social link to the website until Kevin has confirmed ownership of the exact account.
Do not publish weak gameplay images or videos.
Use creature, message, clue, current or route in public writing instead of companion or signal.
Generated artwork must be labelled and must never be presented as gameplay.
NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.
Replies are written or approved by a named adult; do not automate conversations with children.
Never invent followers, reactions, players or popularity.
nextRequiredAction: Kevin approves the PlayMythicalVoid handle family, then checks and claims it himself on the first chosen platform with recovery and multi-factor security in place.
